description: This file defines a React functional component named 'App' that manages a theme toggle between light and dark modes. It includes UI elements such as a button to switch themes, an image logo, and links, with styling imported from CSS. The component uses React hooks (useState, useEffect) to handle state and side effects.

methods.name: App
methods.description: React functional component that renders the theme toggle UI and manages theme state.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Function to toggle the theme state between 'light' and 'dark'.
